test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'CRAVE' is written as 'HVFZJ' and 'ROUND' is written as 'WSZRI'. How will 'BIRDY' be written in the same code language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ab2d7d01890c13fe5922949a98948afcbc7db9666a9a41054d0615e87c718d4.png] 

**Logic:** Addition of (5) and (4) alternatively into the positional values of letters.

'CRAVE' is written as 'HVFZJ' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94a4625c112703c2681837aca5bb4dc5abcac2535620a8670f27a8776b5700d5.png] 

'ROUND' is written as 'WSZRI' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2cc5b0f871dd8b81e00d80a50804ffc3f4159be96bbe40b15ce719863b47208.png] 

Similarly, 'BIRDY' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a3750ee52873a4726191513886c923f42e8f56d3c06b15f6060945638f4a5ee.png] 

Here, 'BIRDY' is written as **'GMWHD'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
